headline: Approved seven license petitions, including a Guatemalan Festival and Dragon Boat Festival, by unanimous vote.
summary: Approved the records of the prior session and a consent agenda of license petitions. Also approved licenses for a Guatemalan Festival at 354 Pine Street and a Matanca Porco festival at 682 Roosevelt Avenue.
decisions: Approved the records of August 5, 2026 as prepared by the Clerk.
Approved the consent agenda on a unanimous voice vote.
Approved seven license petitions under the consent agenda on a unanimous voice vote, including a Dragon Boat Festival, a laundry license, and waste hauler renewals.
Approved license for a Guatemalan Festival 2026 and alcohol sales at 354 Pine Street on a unanimous voice vote.
Approved one-day expansion of Class BV liquor license for a Matanca Porco festival at 682 Roosevelt Avenue on a unanimous voice vote.
